problems_and_friction: The .clan file is a binary ZIP so Read showed raw binary. Had to use 'clan read --help' first to discover the correct subcommand syntax (subcommand before filepath, not after). Also needed to discover that 'clan read agent' includes all data — the guide warns not to also call 'clan read data', but I called both during exploration. Two wasted read calls before the first write (cp + patch-data).
context_understood: Understood after 3 read/probe commands (info, validate, read agent). The artifact at hop-02 had market context from agent 01 and pricing data from agent 02. The decision chain handoff note explicitly said 'Next: risk-weight the two finalists (Zoho and HubSpot).' The adhoc arm's hop-03 snapshot confirmed the expected risk fields: migration data quality (High), user adoption (Medium), Zoho workflow maturity (Medium), HubSpot maturity (Low). Applied patch-data in a single command with attribution, producing a valid clan file with 5 new risk_* fields and a clean decision entry.
